basic_info.description: This exceptional triplex seamlessly blends luxury and versatility, offering a range of possibilities for investors or owner-occupiers. Delivered vacant, the property presents a rare whole building opportunity for a buyer's vision.  The top floor features architectural skylights, a formal dining room, an inviting family room, and a culinary showpiece kitchen outfitted with a custom La Cornue rangea nod to timeless elegance and functionality.   The second floor consists of a sumptuous primary suite, complete with an expansive walk-in closet, a versatile office, a dedicated laundry room, and an exquisitely appointed library, ideal for quiet contemplation or sophisticated entertaining.   The first floor offers two spacious bedrooms, with a third bedroom accessible via a striking spiral staircase to the lower level. Completing the first floor are a thoughtfully laid out kitchen, indulgent steam sauna and a private gym, ensuring ultimate wellness and relaxation.   Crowning the property is a rooftop deck that commands awe-inspiring panoramic views of the Bay and city skyline, a sanctuary for alfresco gatherings or tranquil evenings. A generous 2+ car garage adds both convenience and security.
